purpose: Define deterministic resolution of canonical semantic identities and references before Topic, structure, behavior or mechanism projections are evaluated.

value.identity_rule: One active canonical semantic identity resolves to exactly one active semantic definition.
value.reference_rule: Every active canonical reference resolves to exactly one active semantic identity.
value.ordering_rule: Identity and reference resolution occurs before Topic inheritance, Topic composition, Topic coverage, structure projection or behavior projection.

value.purpose: Group deterministic canonical identity and reference resolution.

invariants.rule: Canonical identity originates from explicit structured identity data.
Canonical cross-definition references use explicit structured references.

hard_gates.condition: One canonical identity resolves to more than one active semantic definition.
An active reference resolves to zero active semantic identities.
An active reference resolves to multiple active semantic identities.
Canonical semantic identity or reference target requires filesystem-path inference.
Canonical identity is inferred from Topic membership or Topic proximity.

references.purpose: Implements the Contract Format 1.4 identity and reference-resolution rules.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.

prose.summary: Canonical identities and references are resolved explicitly and deterministically before higher-level Topic, structure or mechanism interpretation.
notes: Unlocked until the exact identity of the Contract Format root and repository-wide active reference closure are validated in the assembled review tree.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.
